packaging.single_owner: Actual source bytes reside only in mapping targets; old src and code/shared/_compat/data3001 entries are relative symlinks, not duplicate implementations.
packaging.compatibility_tree: code/shared/_compat/data3001 recreates the original package directory structure using real dirs and individual-file relative symlinks to relocated sources and package assets; src/data3001 routes to it for legacy source-path receipts.
packaging.wheel_caveat: Explicit package-dir plus multi-directory __path__ alone does not collect modules from every physical directory. Build from the compatibility tree or provide a manifest-aware build_py. Verify wheel and sdist contents, not only editable imports.
packaging.historical_hash_caveat: paths.py, common/runtime.py and MDN runtime are frozen scientific-run source dependencies. Retain original bytes in provenance; frozen source validation must resolve historical path+expected SHA to historical snapshot without changing old receipts. Current execution sources need a distinct post-migration identity. Do not silently resume historical runs with changed sources.
packaging.sibling_lookups: Original logical import locations preserve most Path(__file__).parent and with_name lookups through the compatibility tree. Any .resolve() before parent lookup follows the actual relocated target, so root helpers and showcase asset lookup must change.
